name: glow
description: Generative Layer Over Web — real-time personalization overlay for any website

scripts.build:extension: npx vite build --config extension/vite.config.ts && npx vite build --config extension/vite.config.content.ts && cp extension/manifest.json dist/extension/ && mkdir -p dist/extension/panel && cp extension/panel/panel.html dist/extension/panel/ && mkdir -p dist/extension/icons && cp extension/icons/*.png dist/extension/icons/
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist core/dist indexer/dist extension/dist worker/dist snippet/dist
